name: HC34b: Substituted within the 1st-2nd-3rd line
description:
Number of active non-suppressed ART clients who had HIV drug-resistance testing and whose subsequent clinical outcome was substitution of ARVs while remaining within the same regimen line.
The client must have a previous valid non-suppressed VL, completed HIVDR testing with results returned, a decision in the reporting period, and outcome = 'Non-suppressed & Substituted'. The underlying form also explicitly defines the corresponding clinical decision as “Non-suppressed and substituted within the same regimen.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT n.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_non_suppressed_card n
WHERE n.patient_id IS NOT NULL

  AND n.hivdr_sample_collected = 'Yes'
  AND (
      n.hivdr_results IS NOT NULL
      OR n.date_hivr_results_recieved_at_facility IS NOT NULL
  )

  AND n.date_of_decision >= :startDate
  AND n.date_of_decision < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

  AND n.outcome = 'Non-suppressed & Substituted'

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
      WHERE v.patient_id = n.patient_id
        AND v.result_status = 'VALID'
        AND v.is_unsuppressed = 1
        AND v.is_suppressed = 0
        AND COALESCE(
              v.sample_collection_date,
              v.viral_load_clinical_date,
              v.laboratory_result_date,
              v.order_date
            ) <= n.date_of_decision
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = n.patient_id
        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
